SUMMARY
A modern one-bedroom apartment in Equity Chambers, BD1, featuring a spacious bedroom, a large open-plan lounge/kitchen area, a fitted kitchen and bathroom, and an excellent city centre location close to local amenities and transport links.

DESCRIPTION
Situated in the heart of Bradford city centre, this well-presented one-bedroom flat in the sought-after Equity Chambers development (BD1) offers modern and comfortable living. The property features a spacious double bedroom, providing plenty of room for storage and relaxation, alongside a large open-plan lounge and kitchen area that creates a bright and welcoming living space. Comes with fitted kitchen providing ample workspace. In the bathroom there is a classic white fitted suite. Ideally located within walking distance of shops, restaurants, transport links, and local amenities, this apartment is perfect for professionals or anyone looking to enjoy convenient city centre living.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.

Hallway 
With doorway to the front.

Lounge/Kitchen Area 17' 5" x 16' 6" ( 5.31m x 5.03m )
Fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units and large spacious reception area.

Bedroom 15' 9" into recess x 13' 9" ( 4.80m into recess x 4.19m )
With windows to the rear and electric heating unit.

Bathroom 
Fitted bathroom comprising of a panel bath, wash hand basin and WC.

Lease details are currently being compiled.  For further information please contact the branch.  Please note additional fees could be incurred for items such as leasehold packs.
